title: appointments.availability.slots
description: The date to list, and nothing else about the business (appointments#127): the opening hours, the agenda and the settings are read from the hub by the runtime (`reads`), never sent by the caller — hours a caller supplies are hours a caller can forge.

date.description: The business's own calendar date (`2026-08-03`), the same key a special day or an override is written under.

duration_minutes.description: How long each slot lasts. Absent = the hub's `default_duration`. The slot has to fit WHOLE inside an open stretch, so this is what decides whether the last hour before closing is still offered.

staff_id.description: List ONE professional's free slots. Absent = the whole agenda: any appointment or block of the hub counts.
